newsitem.title: FINLAND: Hackman in talks to sell Hackman TTT.
newsitem.headline: Hackman in talks to sell Hackman TTT.

text.p: Finnish consumer goods group Hackman Oy Ab said in a statement on Monday it had started talks with U.S. Massachusetts based firm Simonds Holding on the sale of its blades and machine parts unit Hackman TTT.
"Hackman TTT belongs to Hackman group's industry division. Its net sales are 125 million markka and it employs 255 people," Hackman said.
Its clients are in the heavy forest industry, it said.
The planned disposal included Hackman TTT's subsidiaries Hackman TTT GmbH and Peerless Saw Company.
Hackman's CEO Curt Lindbom told Reuters that Hackman aimed to finalise a deal by the end of the year but he declined to give any further details on the plans or the talks.
"The end of the year would be a natural time to transfer the unit," Lindbom said.
